aiVerification.summary: Draft is not approvable because it conflates holder-change validation with unrelated tracking and process checks.
issues: Changed factor is nonsensical and over-broad.
Before/after holder comparison is not preserved.
Daily and total rows are treated as changed conditions.
Material, mold, process-stage tracking is wrongly merged.
Some outcomes are context-only root-cause checks.
correctionPlan: Set primary changed factor to AOI vision and Press VP holder change.
Use before vs after holder for NG air leak, with dates as subgroups.
Keep VP vision after-holder result as post-change confirmation unless baseline exists.
Move process, material, and tracking sheets to separate cases or context.
Cite purpose, content, headers, data, and conclusion rows for each case.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient for final evidence.
